text: Reprojection: keep fabric-artwork's 2×2 tent-splat of points (avoids pixelation from single-pixel splats)
description: Each reprojected pixel is splatted to 2×2 targets with bilinear tent weights (fabric-artwork reproject-points.vs/.fs). Single-pixel splats give 8 quantised directions and a pixelated look. The accumulated weight is the certainty. This is proven; don't question it lightly.
